trigger: The outcome-free R2 input audit produced 81 safe fields and an effective-information ratio of 8.909497618455376 versus R0, below the pre-frozen 10.0 gate.
scientific_decision: Do not lower the x10 threshold. Add substantively interpretable, previously unused variables from the already catalogued RGPH2014 individual/household files and ENCDM2014 household donor file.
epistemic_boundary: RGPH fields are observed only for anonymous source microdata profiles. ENCDM fields are statistically matched latent household characteristics and must be labelled as such in every handoff; they are not observed facts about a real person.
